status: NOMINAL COMPONENT AND LAYOUT REVIEW; ELECTRICAL QUALIFICATION OPEN
open_items: Bias, temperature, tolerance and aging must be combined for effective capacitance; no guaranteed operating-point capacitance has been established.
TI LC table covers nominal combinations with +20/-50 percent effective capacitance variation; this is not proof the chosen Samsung part meets that envelope in Phoenix.
APV table labels 4.98 A saturation and 4.32 A heat-rating columns Max., alongside 6.00 A and 5.00 A typical. Do not relabel these as guaranteed minimum ratings without clarification.
Current-dependent inductance, load transients, ripple, loop stability, input source impedance and passive thermal performance remain unqualified.
The main input branch is geometrically continuous; current and thermal capability, other board supply loads and the Wi-Fi ferrite/output feed remain unfinished.
